published_source.layout: single MOSA 30x10 station rectangle at 10m, 3 consecutive trap nights monthly, March 1994-February 2023
published_source.nonterritorial_context: Prior behavioral work documents broadly nonterritorial, overlapping home ranges; this is literature context, not a test of mechanism by itself.

relationship_to_failed_NEON_hypotheses.meaning: Independent species-site-year sequence, not an independent exact NEON 10x10/3night multigenus replication; never replace failed genera with Mastomys.

pre_response_structural_gate.date_interpretation: fully specified and unambiguous before spatial metrics

ecological_questions.primary: Does crowding in a largely nonterritorial rodent correlate with within-individual positional contraction and relatively larger among-individual centroid dispersion on the same three-night spatial scale?
ecological_questions.competing: Is the density-associated spatial response dominated by the compression of between-animal centres (beta_B < 0 and Delta <= 0), or is there no identifiable density association?
ecological_questions.no_prior_density_mechanism: No claimed causal social interaction, home-range territory, resource competition, or stable universal mammalian rule.

frozen_responses.W: half mean squared within-tag pairwise trap-station distance across two or three distinct capture nights in eligible monthly session
frozen_responses.B: among distinct individual three-night trap-coordinate centroids variance, debiased by individual positional uncertainty, in m²
frozen_responses.geometry: 1..30 × A..J with 10m station spacing; no numerical comparison of unstandardized MOSA slope magnitudes with NEON 10x10

frozen_predictor.MNA: monthly Minimum Number Alive using encounter histories of same marked individuals across the 1994-2023 MOSA series; account for corrected toe-code identity, do not treat Toe ID text as continuous across documented re-use

prospective_analytical_model.unit: one 3-night primary month of one MOSA site
prospective_analytical_model.dependence: year-block bootstrap / clustered year with at least 10 supported independent years; preserve within-year autocorrelation
prospective_analytical_model.primary_direction: beta_Delta>0; do not convert a negative/null result to success
prospective_analytical_model.required_support_for_positive_inference: beta_Delta point positive and 95% year-block percentile/bootstrap CI lower >0
secondary_observation_sensitivity: equal repeated-capture m cohort and m-adjusted MNA response
prospective_analytical_model.report_absolute_null: also report observed total spatial variance W+B vs MNA without claiming variance conservation from algebra alone

falsification_and_scope.primary_failed_if: beta_Delta<=0 or year-block interval includes zero
falsification_and_scope.strong_packing_failed_if: beta_W>=0 or beta_B<0, even if beta_Delta positive
falsification_and_scope.if_positive: one-species, one-site longitudinal association with density across spatial scales in a broadly nonterritorial species; cannot infer territorial mechanism or multigenus generality
falsification_and_scope.if_negative: independent nontransportability of specific sign across ecology and geometry, not a universal opposite law
forbidden: retroactively selecting only favorable years, seasons, age or sex
tuning m or changing temporal bout from three to two nights
calling a single-site effect independent multi-site replication
equating monthly MNA with true density or behavioral cues

time_boundary: This document locks ecological direction before any MOSA individual spatial metric or abundance slope is calculated; if source and structural gate fail it remains a method-only artifact.
